name: basic-cloud-infra
description: Basic Cloud Infrastructure for deploying Apps using an ALB

scripts.deploy:staging: npm run build && cdk deploy --require-approval never --app "ts-node bin/cloud-infra-app.ts --env Staging --account your-staging-account-id"
scripts.deploy:prod: npm run build && cdk deploy --require-approval never --app "ts-node bin/cloud-infra-app.ts --env Production --account your-prod-account-id"
